bio: Run by chef Gaël Ruscart, this fine establishment in the heart of the city revolves around inventive and masterful cooking. Fish and seafood ingredients are elevated in refined dishes: langoustines, flaked spider crab, smoked haddock and lime cream; scallops, parsnip mousseline with candied lemon, langoustine cream. Harmonious flavours meet technical prowess in this welcoming and elegant setting....
